notes: Text master for the robot's word lines: the gag line after a correct answer, and the broken-Hebrew guess on a new picture. Kept in its own file instead of gag_line / he_line in claude/flip-word-list.json, so the picture batch and the voice work never overwrite each other's edits. Voice: "flip robot character" (eLkzmL7sIxy7PLUgCfeT) on eleven_v4. [tags] are ElevenLabs audio tags; they describe sounds and delivery, never actions (actions live in the poses). pose = hand poses in order; recipe = tone recipe 1-6 in the doc; win = the picture's win move from the word list, which the gag line plays with. Writing rules from the human's review (2026-10-19, round 2): every gag says the word, clearly, best at the start; very simple English a beginner of 9-10 knows, about 10 spoken words or fewer; the fun is silly, childish and ridiculous, carried by sounds and acting (animal noises, squeaky voices, crashes, sneezes, dizzy spins) rather than wordplay or clever English. Robot moments (v4, 2026-10-21, his tag style): about one robot sound per line, between phrases, never on the target word or a Hebrew word; pauses use [short pause] / [pause]. A Hebrew guess plays on a new picture (in place of a shared picture line, about 1 in 6 times the word comes up): mangled Hebrew, a silly beat, then the English word, a bridge from Hebrew to English. status: approved = words seen and approved by the human (only tags changed in v4); draft = new, to review. Animals and Transport approved 2026-10-19 (round 2); Food drafted 2026-10-19; Home drafted 2026-10-21. Approvals now live only on the Robot Line Review page (https://claude.ai/artifact/5fmw8W8FCej3MgeMkAtwmu, one tab per theme plus Robot lines): a line is done when he marked Keep there or it was approved earlier; Change or Drop sends it back to Claude. 2026-10-22: he kept every Food and Home line on the page (including the 12 earlier 'revised'/'draft' ones), so all 64 Food and Home words are approved. he_status = the Hebrew guess's own status where it differs. 2026-10-24: lines drafted for the 19 new animal and 21 new transport words (all 130 words now have a gag line), plus 4 new Hebrew guesses (hen, elephant, bag, map); helicopter and motorbike rewritten from his notes. 2026-10-24 (pass 5): animals reviewed — 16 new animal gags and the elephant Hebrew guess approved; ant, bug and panda rewritten from his notes; transport and the hen Hebrew guess not reviewed yet.

blanket.gag: Blanket! [flapping] Whoosh! [short pause] [muffled, robotic beep] Who turned off the light?

kitchen.gag: Kitchen! [pot lid rattling] Ooh! [sniffing] Spaghetti? [stomach rumbles, electronic glitch] My memory is hungry again!

umbrella.gag: This is an umbrella. [short pause] You always need one… [rain pattering, electronic glitch] when you forget to bring one.
umbrella.old_gag: Umbrella! [wind whooshing] Whoa! Hold on! [metal creaking] [short pause] Bye-bye, umbrella!

toothbrush.gag: Toothbrush! [brushing fast] Brush brush brush! [foam bubbling, electronic glitch] Wait… I have no teeth!
